usafacts_voter_registration.name: USAFacts Voter Registration by Party Affiliation
usafacts_voter_registration.description: USAFacts compiled county voter registration by party affiliation from state election offices for the 27 states and Washington, DC, that record party affiliation and publish it by county. One report is used per year, the one closest to November; the most recent is generally from early 2026. Most states span 2016 to 2026, but Kentucky starts in 2017, Idaho and Rhode Island in 2018, and California, Connecticut, and Massachusetts end in 2025. Only active voters are counted in states that separate active and inactive registrations. Connecticut is reported for its eight former counties.
